description: Shadow Mole default look, PIXEL-SAMPLED from design/reference/shadow_mole-character-sheet.png: the five palette chips (intake.json swatches 22,14,25 body / 23,15,26 shadow / 230,47,132 pink primary / 227,148,189 pink highlight / 186,34,105 pink accent) + medians of the drawn surfaces over the back + side views (sheet box x 442-1201, y 260-660; masks: body = purple-tinted near-black, burrow = neutral near-black, pink = R > 110 and R - G > 40). Near-black mole on a near-black cloud burrow with a deeper black opening, bright pink stalks / claws / petals with pale-pink petal streaks. No glow anywhere (the sheet draws none; question M1 open).
